_widenedComment: WIDENED 2026-08-29 by STERLING_PEAK, hub kit role migration Phase 0.E3 (PLAN-hubKitRoleMigration-082826.md). The three null measuredPreMigration entries are now filled with ids MEASURED in Phase 0.M2/0.M3 at HEAD 66c5c60 on branch hubKitRole-082826. WHAT THIS DOES AND DOES NOT DO: test-gId.js iterates MIGRATED_FORGE_ROSTER, not this object, so filling these entries does NOT by itself widen the gate's coverage — it ARMS it. Coverage arrives per phase as each forge joins the roster (ceds Phase 1, sif Phase 3, pesc260805 Phase 4). The roster was deliberately NOT touched here: test-gId.js also requires each roster member's frozen-command scratch standardsDatabase to exist on disk with phase token 'migrated', and those do not exist for ceds, sif or pesc260805, so adding them now would produce ONE-MACHINE-ONLY refusals rather than measurements.

_referenceUnderFourWithHubBaselineIsHist.why: These values describe ONE REAL ARTIFACT still on disk — system/dataStores/graphBuilder/forgeFramework_fourWithHub_postEdfi.standardsDatabase.sqlite3, which test-gId.js reads by absolute path for its fourForgeManifestEqualsReference conjunct. Rewriting them to today's values would make the object disagree with the store it describes and would break a currently-passing gate. They are left exactly as found.
_referenceUnderFourWithHubBaselineIsHist.PESC_LANDMINE_FOR_PHASE_4: referenceUnderFourWithHubBaseline.pesc260805 is db885ac4… and is TWO GENERATIONS STALE relative to the current tree. The lineage recorded in lib/bridge-framework/test/acceptance/acceptanceCommands.jsonc:439-449 (pesc260805BaseBlockIdHistory, every entry stamped with buildMode per RULING P2-R4) is: db885ac4… [vectorize=true, pre-re-embed] -> 045523dc… [vectorize=true, P0b searchText re-embed] -> (c46991d1… [vectorize=FALSE, SUPERSEDED, NOT A LINEAGE MEMBER]) -> f139654a… [vectorize=true, CURRENT, RULING P1-R8 rendering-seat stamp]. test-gId.js asserts `recordedId === frozenId && recordedId === referenceId`, so when pesc260805 joins MIGRATED_FORGE_ROSTER in Phase 4 the referenceId half WILL FAIL against db885ac4… for a reason that has nothing to do with the migration. Phase 4 must reconcile the reference — either by re-pointing it at a fresh fourWithHub-baseline store or by splitting the conjunct — BEFORE adding pesc260805 to the roster. Recorded here rather than discovered there.
_referenceUnderFourWithHubBaselineIsHist.ceds_edfi_sif: Measured Phase 0 values EQUAL their references. Only pesc260805 diverges.

_postEmbedTextComment: RECORDED 2026-09-15 by RADIANT_QUEST (forge embed-text revision P8, PLAN-forgeEmbedText-091426.md R-ET-10; campaign head 44ceddc). The embed-text campaign gives every chosen text field its own framework-minted DmeEmbedText node (Ed-Fi 3,281, CEDS 6,684 — the P1 oracle), so the Ed-Fi and CEDS StandardBase block ids MOVE BY DESIGN. The NEW ids are recorded here as measuredPostEmbedText with full provenance. THREE THINGS THIS EDIT DELIBERATELY DOES NOT DO: (1) measuredPreMigration is NOT rewritten — G-ID (test-gId.js) reads the RECORDED `migrated` store on disk (forgeFramework_edfi_migrated, 2026-08-16, aea6d8df…) and asserts the framework migration reproduced the unmigrated id; that claim is about that store and remains TRUE, so the row and the roster stay as they are. (2) referenceUnderFourWithHubBaseline is NOT edited — it describes the historical fourWithHub_postEdfi store (see the sibling note); its four-forge SUCCESSOR is the P10 GOLD_EVAL build and will be recorded as its own section when it exists, never by overwriting the reference. (3) NO gate was re-pointed at the new store: the frozen command was re-run under a NEW phase token (embedText) precisely so the recorded `migrated` run is never overwritten (runAcceptanceCommand.js refuses to overwrite a recorded run).

sif.OBSERVED_EDGE_COLLAPSE: SIF is the ONLY standard of the four whose harvest returns fewer edges than the load: 'loading 27069 nodes, 88766 edges' -> 'harvested 27069 nodes, 88757 edges'. NINE edges collapse under MERGE at the load boundary. It is REPRODUCIBLE (the block id equals the anchor, so the collapse is baked into every prior measurement too) and NODE counts are exact, so invariant I11 is unaffected. Docketed, not fixed — CEDS does not need it. See hubKitRole/DOCKET-bugsNotFixed.md.
